key.name: dock-orientation
key.description: Whether the dock sits at the top or the bottom of the screen. The extension stores this value and does not apply it yet.

key.name: monitor-panels
key.description: Maps a monitor connector to that monitor's panel settings. Each entry may contain panel-enabled (boolean) and icons (a dictionary of icon id to boolean). Missing monitors and icons stay enabled. The extension stores these values and does not apply them yet.
